title: processkit CLI result envelope
description: The one JSON document a command writes to standard output with --json (cli@v1 PK-OUT-001, PK-OUT-006). Unknown members are not allowed; consumers reject an unknown apiVersion.

apiVersion.description: Version of the CLI result contract.

command.description: Command path, subcommands joined by one space. Discriminates the shape of 'data'.

root.description: Absolute path of the selected repository root, or null when the command selected none.

revision.description: Working-copy revision in the shape of repository-storage@v1 schemas/revision.schema.json, or null when the command selected no repository root.

data.description: Command-specific payload. For commands with an MCP equivalent it equals the MCP tool's structured result. Null when the command produced no result.

plan.description: Present exactly for writing commands (init, new, format, lock, migrate, fetch) once a plan was computed.

changes.description: Present exactly for writing commands: the repository files actually changed, sorted by path, shape per repository-storage@v1 file-change.schema.json. Empty with --dry-run and on refusal.
